location: RNS Institute of Technology Grounds, Bengaluru

summary.en: A two-day tournament bringing batches together.
summary.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಚ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೆಡೆ ತಂದ ಎರಡು ದಿನಗಳ ಪಂದ್ಯಾವಳಿ.

body: The seventh edition of the Navodaya Cricket League (NCL) was organized as a two-day sports tournament, bringing together alumni from different batches to compete and reconnect through the spirit of cricket.
